defs.def: the function or position that sb has or is expected to have in an organization, in society or in a relationship 职能；地位；角色

ex.s: For many years, psychologists saw identity as a combination of someone’s values, beliefs, goals and social roles.

ex.t: 我们有项目经理、登山领队和沟通干事等角色。

ex.s: Depending on which role you choose，you could help to increase a community's access to safe drinking water，or help to protect valuable local cultures.

ex.s: Nielsen always felt he should be doing comedy but his good looks and distinguished voice kept him busy in dramatic roles.

ex.s: It wasn’t until1980 - 32 years into his career — that he landed the role it would seem he was made for in Airplane!
ex.t: 直到1980年——他职业生涯的第32年——他才得到那个似乎为他量身打造的角色，即在《飞机！》中出演。

ex.s: He was thrilled to be doing the comedy that he always felt he should do, but even during his last few years, he always had a sense of curiosity, wondering what new role or challenge might be just around the corner.
ex.t: 他为自己能出演一直觉得应该演的喜剧而兴奋，但即使在生命的最后几年，他也始终保持着好奇心，想知道下一个新的角色或挑战可能就在眼前。

ex.s: He focused on playing dramatic roles.
ex.t: 他专注于扮演戏剧性的角色。

ex.s: Good Morning Britain’s Susanna Reid is used to grilling guests on the sofa every morning, but she is cooking up a storm in her latest role — showing families how to prepare delicious and nutritious meals on a tight budget.
ex.t: 《早安英国》的苏珊娜·里德习惯每天早上在沙发上盘问嘉宾，但在她最新的角色里，她正大显身手——教家庭如何在预算紧张的情况下准备美味又营养的饭菜。

ex.s: However, becoming a full-time, successful actor would still be an uphill battle for another eight years until he landed a number of film roles that finally got him noticed.

ex.s: Sometimes, the parents ___28___ complain about the role of screens in family life are just as guilty of spending too much time in front of one.

ex.s: Ask the audience to contribute their ideas or to take a role in explaining new concepts and policies to others.
ex.t: 请听众贡献想法，或让他们承担向他人解释新概念和新政策的角色。

ex.s: While he held the notion that objective reality exists, he said our mind plays a necessary role in structuring and shaping our perceptions.
ex.t: 虽然他持有客观现实存在的观念，但他说我们的心智在构建和塑造我们的感知中扮演着必要的角色。

ex.s: Movement in art has an interesting role.
ex.t: 艺术中的运动扮演着有趣的角色。

ex.s: For young people, information technology skills will play an increasing role in the future.
ex.t: 对年轻人来说，信息技术技能在未来将扮演越来越重要的角色。

ex.s: Preventing / Prevented from playing her role in Riley’s emotional development, Sadness feels annoyed.
ex.t: 由于被阻止在Riley的情感发展中扮演自己的角色，Sadness感到烦恼。

ex.s: My friends checked and came back shouting, “Amy, you got the main role! ” Sure enough, my name was at the top.
ex.t: 我的朋友们查看后跑回来喊道："艾米，你拿到主角了！"果然，我的名字在最上面。

ex.s: He is a star actor of Children’s Theatre, having played leading roles in “The Legend of Sleepy Hollow” and “The Wizard of Oz,” and is fresh from Jersey Production “Ragtime.”

defs.def: the degree to which sb/sth is involved in a situation or an activity and the effect that they have on it 影响程度；作用

ex.s: It centered on fathers’ role in parenting.
ex.t: 它聚焦于父亲在育儿中的作用。

ex.s: In their new book Movement: How to Take Back Our Streets and Transform Our Lives, they call for a rethink of our streets and the role they play in our lives.
ex.t: 在他们的新书《Movement：如何收回我们的街道并改变我们的生活》中，他们呼吁重新思考街道及其在我们生活中的作用。

ex.s: He says food   1   (play) a big role in his life.
ex.t: 他说食物在他生活中___1___（play）重要作用。

ex.s: “There are relatively few studies that stress the unique role of fathers,” Padilla-Walker said.
ex.t: "强调父亲独特作用的研究相对较少，"Padilla-Walker说。

ex.s: While 78 percent of parents said they believed they were good screen time role models, the study found a disconnect between their behavior and their perception of their behavior.
ex.t: 虽然78%的父母说他们相信自己是有良好屏幕时间榜样的人，但研究发现他们的行为与他们对自身行为的认知之间存在脱节。

ex.s: Beyond visitor interaction, AI plays a crucial role in preserving priceless artworks.
ex.t: 除了访客互动，人工智能在保护无价艺术品方面也发挥着关键作用。

ex.s: Furniture Restoration: take an active role in transforming reclaimed furniture and materials into useful items, giving them a new life;
ex.t: 创意工作坊：学习旧家具的基本维修和艺术改造，同时与 fellow 志愿者分享知识和想法，

ex.s: Digital texts, audio and video all have educational roles, especially when providing resources not available in print.
ex.t: 电子文本、音频和视频都有其教育作用，尤其是在提供纸质材料无法获得的资源时。

ex.s: In rural areas, where ambulances can take a relatively long time to arrive, the phone boxes have taken on a lifesaving role.
ex.t: 在农村地区，救护车可能需要相对较长的时间才能到达，电话亭因此发挥了挽救生命的作用。

ex.s: Several recent studies examined the role of talent in the sports world.
ex.t: 最近几项研究考察了天赋在体育界中的作用。

ex.s: Habitat Restoration Team volunteers play a vital role in restoring sensitive resources and protecting endangered species across the ridges and valleys.
ex.t: 栖息地修复团队的志愿者在恢复敏感资源、保护山脊与山谷间的濒危物种方面发挥着重要作用。

ex.s: It is fair to say, though, that our psychological biases play a major role.
ex.t: 不过，公平地说，我们的心理偏见起着主要作用。

ex.s: They say it can play a big role in calming the brain enough to sleep．
ex.t: 他们说，它在让大脑平静下来、足以入睡方面能发挥很大作用。

ex.s: Yet the researchers suggest that single parents still may play a role in teaching the benefits of persistence, which is an avenue of future research.
ex.t: 然而，研究人员指出，单亲父母仍可能在教导坚持的好处方面发挥作用，这是未来研究的一个方向。

ex.s: Phytoplankton play a declining role in the marine ecosystem.
ex.t: 浮游植物在海洋生态系统中扮演的作用在下降。

ex.s: Eventually, realising / realised that every emotion has a role, Joy understands it is okay for Riley to feel sad sometimes.

ex.s: It is believed that EQ plays an even more important role than IQ (intelligence quotient) in people’s lives.
ex.t: 人们认为，情商在人们的生活中起着比智商（智商）更重要的作用。

ex.s: In China, volunteers are also playing an increasingly important role in environmental protection, disability assistance and many other fields.
ex.t: 在中国，志愿者在环境保护、残疾人援助和许多其他领域也发挥着越来越重要的作用。
